<!ELEMENT type_of_fuel (#PCDATA)>

<!ELEMENT chassis_number (#PCDATA)>

<!ELEMENT accessories EMPTY>

<!ATTLIST accessories
    disc_brake (yes|no) #REQUIRED
    auto_start (yes|no) #REQUIRED
    radio (yes|no) #REQUIRED>

tasks.title: Live Name Suggestions (jQuery AJAX & PHP)
tasks.question: Experiment 11: Implement a live search suggestion box using jQuery AJAX and PHP. As the user types characters into an input field, send asynchronous requests to a PHP script containing an array of names and display matching autocomplete suggestions in real time.
tasks.aim: To build an interactive autocomplete search widget using jQuery keyup event listeners, asynchronous GET requests, and PHP substring array filtering.

files.name: search.php
files.content:
<?php

// List of sample names
$names = ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie", "David",
          "Emma", "Ethan", "Sophia", "Samuel",
          "Olivia", "Liam"];

// Check whether query is received
if (isset($_GET['query'])) {

    // Get the entered character
    $query = trim($_GET['query']);

    // Create empty suggestions list
    $suggestions = [];

    // Search for matching names
    if ($query != "") {

        foreach ($names as $name) {

            if (stripos($name, $query) !== false) {

                $suggestions[] = $name;

            }

        }

    }

    // Display matching names
    if (empty($suggestions)) {

        echo "No suggestions";

    } else {

        echo implode(", ", $suggestions);

    }

}

?>
